text:
Marta R: Quick q — flew to SF last week and split the booking across my personal card + Redwood card because the return fare was cheaper. I uploaded boarding passes and both card statements but expense portal flagged missing hotel folio.
Jules (People Ops): Hey Marta — thanks. Per-diem is calculated per night, but for mixed payments we need clear proof of who paid what. Can you upload the hotel folio (itemized bill) showing room rate + taxes? Airbnb receipts are fine but we need host invoice or booking confirmation.
Marta R: I booked hotel via aggregator so I only have an invoice PDF that says "booking fee" and a separate card charge. Will that work?
Jules (People Ops): Usually yes — upload the invoice + the card statement line that shows the charge. On the expense form mark the hotel as "partially paid by company" and enter the amount Redwood covered.
Samir: If we have an overnight layover (arrive evening, leave next morning) do we claim two per-diem days or one? I had a 14-hr connection in ORD and ate 3 meals there.
Liz C: Generally per-diem is per-night away. Layovers that don't include an overnight stay at destination don't add extra nights. Meals during connection are expensed under receipts up to caps, not additional per-diem.
Jules (People Ops): Correct. For long connections, submit meal receipts under "meals". If the invoice is missing an itemized folio, we may accept hotel email confirmation + proof of payment as exception — ping us and include a short note in the expense report to speed approval.
expense-bot: :warning: Expense submission 243298 for Marta R flagged: missing itemized folio for Hotel - action required.
Marta R: Thanks! I uploaded the invoice + the statement and added a note explaining split payment. Also marked "partial company-paid" and entered amount of $210 that Redwood covered.
Jules (People Ops): Got it — approving once we verify the folio. If the system still blocks, reply here and we'll do a manual approval. Also FYI: for future trips try using the Redwood corporate booking link or call TravelOps; it avoids split charges and speeds reimbursements :thumbsup:
Samir: Thanks for the clarify — saved to notes.
Liz C: :eyes: quick Q for POps — if an employee uses a vendor marketplace that invoices monthly (not instant receipt), do we accept the monthly invoice for reimbursement?
Jules (People Ops): Yes, monthly invoices are allowed but must include line items with dates and employee name and proof of travel. For cardholders, attach the card statement line too. For any odd cases email people-ops@redwood.com and include the invoice and booking confirmations.
Marta R: Appreciated! Saved me a bunch of back-and-forth. :heart:
